summary: Selector-style field getter: on selector 4096 writes the value of this[0x8C] through the output pointer *a2 and returns it; on selector 0x2000 writes this[0x90] through *a2 and returns a2; otherwise leaves *a2 untouched and returns the unmodified selector a3. Used per-frame by the collision detection system.

operations.description: Initialize the result to the selector argument a3.
Branch on selector a3 == 4096 (the 0x1000-valued constant in the raw source).
When selector is 4096, read this[35] (byte offset 0x8C) and write it through the output pointer *a2.
When selector is 0x2000, read this[36] (byte offset 0x90) and write it through the output pointer *a2.
Return the selected field value for selector 4096, the output pointer a2 for selector 0x2000, or the untouched selector a3 otherwise.
